ley.label: Ley de la República

hierarchy.note: Codes only (Código Civil, Código del Trabajo, etc.). Format: 'LIBRO PRIMERO' or 'LIBRO I'. Not present in ordinary leyes.
Present in codes and complex leyes. Format: 'TÍTULO I – DE LAS DISPOSICIONES GENERALES'. Roman numerals.
Below Título in codes; directly below root in simpler complex laws. Format: 'CAPÍTULO I'.
CRITICAL: Párrafo is a HIGHER DIVISION grouping artículos — NOT a subdivision below artículo. Format: 'Párrafo 1°'. Strip degree symbol for eId: sec_1. Confirmed in Código del Trabajo.
Fundamental citable unit. Numbered continuously throughout the law. Format: 'Artículo 1°'. Strip degree symbol for eId: art_1.

Unnumbered paragraph within artículo. Referenced as 'inciso primero', 'inciso segundo', 'inciso final'. No Bluebell keyword — pipeline must post-process unlabelled paragraphs within <article> into <alinea> elements sequentially.
Numbered list items within artículo or inciso. Format: '1°', '2°'. Cited as 'N° 1°' or 'número 1°'.
Sub-items under números or directly under incisos. Format: 'a)', 'b)', 'c)'. Cited as 'letra a)'.
Rare further subdivision under letras. Format: 'i)', 'ii)', 'iii)'.

hcontainers.name: tituloPreliminar
hcontainers.note: Preliminary title in codes (Código Civil: 53 articles). Precedes Libro structure. Model as hcontainer name='tituloPreliminar'.

hcontainers.name: disposicionTransitoria
hcontainers.note: Transitory provisions, typically at the end of codes and some complex leyes.

ley.note: Covers Ley ordinaria, Ley orgánica constitucional (LOC), and Ley de quórum calificado — all structurally identical, differentiated only by required voting quorum. LOCs and qualified-quorum laws may carry a metadata subtype marker.

dfl.label: Decreto con Fuerza de Ley
dfl.note: Issued by President under delegated authority (Art. 64 Constitution). Requires Contraloría toma de razón. Numbered per ministry per year — disambiguate by appending slugified ministry when clashes occur (e.g., 'dfl/2000/1-justicia'). Structurally identical to ley.

dl.label: Decreto Ley
dl.note: Junta de Gobierno instruments (1973–1990). Many remain in force. Politically neutral FRBR URIs: /akn/cl/act/dl/{year}/{number}. Enacting authority recorded as TLCOrganization in metadata ('Junta de Gobierno de la República de Chile'). Flag for human policy review per skill guidance on regime-change legitimacy.

constitucion.label: Constitución Política de la República de Chile

hierarchy.note: 15 chapters in current text. Format: 'CAPÍTULO I – BASES DE LA INSTITUCIONALIDAD'.
Artículos 1° to 129°, numbered continuously across all chapters.

hcontainers.name: disposicionTransitoria
hcontainers.note: Numbered transitory provisions appended after the permanent articles.

constitucion.note: The 1980 Constitution promulgated as Decreto Supremo N° 100 (2005 consolidated text). Two constitutional referendums (2022, 2023) rejected replacement texts — 1980 Constitution remains in force. Work URI anchored to original 1980 promulgation.

frbr.number_note: Strip the thousands-separator period from Chilean citation format. 'Ley N° 21.719' → 21719 in URI. 'Decreto Ley N° 3.500' → 3500. Display layer re-adds separator. DFL numbers may need ministry suffix to disambiguate: '1-justicia', '1-trabajo'.

numbering.insertion_note: Inserted articles use Latin ordinal suffixes: Artículo 5° bis, Artículo 12 ter.

amendments.cross_reference_format: el artículo [N°] de la Ley N° [XX.XXX]

supranational_memberships.note: UN and ILO conventions incorporated as ordinary leyes after ratification. No direct effect.
Chile is an associate member of MERCOSUR only. No supranational direct-effect obligations.
